banner.text: × PLAN DECLINED · THE MARKED CROSS STREET IS INSIDE THE WORK ZONE, 25 FT PAST THE PIN WHERE THE WORK STARTS. WORK INSIDE AN INTERSECTION (MUTCD FIGURES 6P-26/27) ISN'T SUPPORTED. MOVE THAT PIN MORE THAN 37 FT WITH TRAFFIC, PAST THE CROSS STREET, OR MORE THAN 487 FT AGAINST TRAFFIC, SO THE WORK ENDS BEFORE IT. IF THE MARK IS OFF, MARK IT AGAIN WITH MARK ON MAP. NEEDS INPUT
